The core investment asymmetry centers on whether today's 67.7% gross margin represents peak operational earnings at the top of an unsustainable hyperscaler AI capex bubble, or if TSMC's wide-moat structural monopoly will allow it to compound cash flow through process leadership. Bears argue that customer double-ordering, rising inventory days (87 days), and foreign fab operating cost premiums (2%–4% persistent margin drag) will cause multiple compression and margin de-rating once AI infrastructure spending normalizes.
